prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production skill-tree node icons (round medallion emblems) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG whose heroine Lirian is a crimson-moon swordswoman. Image1 is the existing skill icon sheet of this game: match its painterly dark fantasy rendering, black-crimson mood, silver blades, glowing light and sharp detail, but each new icon is a ROUND MEDALLION, not a square card. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image (2048x2048 or larger) with exactly SEVEN separate round emblems in an invisible 4 columns x 2 rows grid, filled left to right, top row first; the bottom-right cell stays completely EMPTY. Each emblem is a perfect circle centered in its own cell, filling about 70% of the cell, with wide transparent margins, never touching other emblems or the canvas edge. Every emblem: a thin metal rim (plain dark-silver rim, simpler and humbler than a major emblem; sapphire-blue enamel rim with silver), a dark inner disc, and ONE bold simple central symbol that stays readable when shrunk to 20 pixels (strong silhouette, high contrast, little clutter). Outside the circles: actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no characters or faces.
EMBLEMS in order: (1) sapphire rim: chained linked rings of blades, a combo chain. (2) KEYSTONE, larger ornate silver-and-sapphire rim with runes: a dancing sword ring of six floating blades. (3) sapphire rim: a flowing river shaped like a blade. (4) sapphire rim: a sword master spirit flame in blue. (5) SIMPLE stat emblem with plain dark-silver rim: an orange energy droplet refilling. (6) SIMPLE stat emblem with plain dark-silver rim: a clock arrow turning backwards. (7) SIMPLE stat emblem with plain dark-silver rim: expanding concentric rings.
